label: TP
reason: User-supplied Referer header flows directly into bar via append("_SafeStuff") which does not sanitize HTML/script tags, then bar is written to HTTP response writer. The X-XSS-Protection header being set to "0" disables browser-side XSS filtering, confirming the vulnerability.

evidence.note: Referer header read, decoded, appended with suffix, and written to response without HTML escaping
